title: [GMCP 203.032.05] Interoperability and quality: Transport, origin, SSRF, DNS, and endpoint security
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-032-05. Prove applicable official-suite and reference-SDK interoperability in both roles, direct-versus-gateway differential behavior, property invariants, transport and platform parity, and published latency, throughput, startup, memory, disk, and fairness budgets. Retain regression fixtures for every incompatibility found. Vector outcome: Network policy validates every URL and redirect, resolves and pins permitted addresses, blocks private/link-local/metadata reachability unless explicitly granted, detects DNS rebinding, enforces host/origin/TLS and certificate rules, and separates proxy trust zones. Localhost impersonation, rebinding, redirect chains, request smuggling, header confusion, downgrade and egress-bypass suites fail closed. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
